address.streetAddress: 1250 E Hallandale Beach Blvd, 808, Hallandale Beach, 33009

staff.name: Alina Denysova
staff.description: Hello! I’m founder of two salons in New York and Hallandale, Miami. Nail Tech with 17 years of experience. Nail instructor with 7 years of experience. I know everything about nails. I do hardware manicure with designs of any complexity and nail extensions of any length and shape. If you want the perfect manicure then this is the place for you!

staff.name: Ksenia
staff.description: Hello! I'm Ksenia. The Nail Tech and instructor with 10 years of experience. I know everything about nails and can do any of your wishes.

reviews.author: Val T…
reviews.body: IF I’m lucky, I’ll never have to find another nail tech! Ksenia is amazing and a true nail artist!!! I receive SO many compliments from everyone, even strangers! I choose a simple manicure BUT it’s immaculate and consistent every single time!!!!

reviews.author: Erica T…
reviews.body: My nails came out so perfect. Hospitality 10/10
